home.researchTitle: Iwiin anan: me tutuin e eñena
home.researchText: Demensia e buwida me arama? Kiwiñ me anan e iwiid? Bwena ngeni eñan, daet, kibu me dengeringer? Uweron me maran me kor, ma mwak me tutuin e epo e pwiye.
home.appTitle: Golden Moments ngeni iPhone, iPad me Android
home.appText: Ap me free e mwak oflain me kudo pija me famili me o mwina, me mendu ngeni divais amen. Desain me kamie: auwo pija me ekay, epo e taiyim, epo e skoa.

faq.q: Me kiwiñ me ekay ngeni engame ma demensia?
faq.a: Kamwitwit ngago eor re bita e mwamwi, omo ekoe erowa, ma eko kowen: pija egbil me e etok, bita ikurin, jigsaws me e mwamwi, kaeodun dorer ngago engame erowa, kala, bingo me pija, ma kad nio kakaraman. Bita me magit ngago amen bita e ouga an kakaraman ean bita ibum. Eko kowen re taim, makur me e bita maka, me eko me e arongeiy me aea test.

faq.q: E kamwitwit me dementia nio eko amwien?
faq.a: E. Omo kamwitwit me pepa me e bita mwitwit ean Golden Moments eko amwien, eko akaun, sign-up me eko daunlod. Kamwitwit nio re mwitwit ean browser ean fon, tablet me kombiuta.

faq.q: E kamwitwit in tutuo bita e iuwin dementia?
faq.a: Eko kamwitwit me e ainganiyen bwe e iuwin dementia, ma Golden Moments eko an dorer me e kiudo me e iuwin ouga. Kamwitwit ma ngago an Golden Moments e bita kakaraman ma an e pwipwi ibum. Bita sekson in tutuo an aen e bita e waneiy me ainganiyen me dorer me e waneiy me research.

faq.q: E kamwitwit nio e omo re engame me bita Alzheimer's?
faq.a: E. Bita gogoro Alzheimer's e bita me e gbil in oron me dementia, ma kamwitwit nio me aiyuin me bita: pija egbil me e pwer, mwaid me eko mwait, ma eko me bita aea tutuo me ba ouga. Etokon, ikurin, ma kaeodun dorer ngago erowa e iuwin ean tutuo me etam oiya erowa, ma eko me bo me e rita.

faq.q: E engame me bita dementia me etam uwan e mwitwit nio?
faq.a: Mwait ibum, e, me engame epwipwi ean arere. Omo kamwitwit Find the same me pija aro, Picture pairs me tile eangit, pepa in kala, me arongeiy an tutuo. Ouga me mwamwit, aea an ouga, ma kaeodun ngago e meta me e da.

faq.q: E dorer ngago an ngaga e kowen?
faq.a: Bita sait eko akaun me eko ad. Anga aea Google Analytics me e aen bita pej ngago engame e rita. Pija ngago ekoe ituga me Photo pairs e ainganiyen re browser engame ma eko bita upload.
Golden Moments e bita amen makur me eko gbil me aiyuin kamwitwit me pija me mwamwi re faimli me amen aea engame, ean web me app eko amwien. Anga eko dokta, ma eko me nio bita medical advice.

about.title: Kamwitwit Epwipwi, Ma Eko Test me Tutuo
about.seoTitle: Dorer me Golden Moments: Rogon anga aea
about.description: Bita ibit ngago kamwitwit an Golden Moments eko timer, skoa me streak, bita pija me e pwer, me dorer me anga kaewen me dementia.
about.lede: Golden Moments e aiyuin kamwitwit me pija me mwamwi ngago amen aea me engame me bita dementia re kamwitwit epwipwi ean arere.
about.bodyHtml:
Nan engame iat enim

Dogin awo katenten engame, e reidamen ngago nane kogon: dorer, memer, e mwiya ngago eto pija iat aiya, me aea bwo wo ean me tengani engame. Eab dogin bwo wo aea ean kaimo, me katow, me katei ian nim ean.

Makur me katenten me bwiema n ninikini ian phone bet app me ebo, e katei ean bwo wo ekaura, me e tsimine score me level me timer. Dogin engame ñe e tsimine dementia, e kakum bwo aea n exam me eab omo bwo wo paas. Am makur e kowawa ian bwo e omo, me a kogon iat kikiñ nane:

  • Eab tsimine fail. Eab tsimine kurok, score, katen ian timer, lives, confetti, me countdown ian aea n screen.
  • Aea me ata, eab aea bwo wo ninikini. Pija e tsimine ngago omo. Dorer me katenten e katei bwo wo dorer me eab kiudoita dogin eg me ninikini me bwiema.
  • E raudo, e eti me e kokow. E raudo dorer me pija, e eti aea, me botin me kontrol e tsimine iat aea n tekinei.
  • Aea n kakarau bwo engame e raudo. Pija n bet ean me dorer me e omo me warm. Eab tsimine cartoon, dorer n meme me praise n ebo, me emoji.
  • E eti bwo wo katei. “E muña ngago nane” e tsimine iat aea. Ngago wo etoga iat nubuwa, e omo ngago nane.
  • Private ian aea. Eab tsimine account me ads. Pija me wo aea e tsimine ian device umen.

Nan a eab katei

Am katenten e dogin bwo wo mwiya me ean dorer. Eab dogin bwo a doctor me test, measure, katei bwo e omo, me slower me prevent dementia me Alzheimer’s disease, me eab omo bwo engame e aea dogin nane. Ngago a dorer dogin research ian peij n ninikini me omo, a dorer e eti ngago evidence eab kor, me a eab eowita me am katenten.

Amen Golden Moments

Golden Moments e kakarau engame me e gidit. A eab clinician me doctor. Am dorer me guide e bita iat dorer n organization me eto, me aea National Institute on Aging me Alzheimer’s Association, me guide e tsimine aea n sources. Aea keit a dorer me aea am peij.

Dorer me kakum bwo a omo

A omo bwo a row ean wo, me nan e omo me nan eab omo, dogin engame ñe e tsimine dementia, famili me amen kakarau engame, me staff n katenten. Email {email}.

editorial.title: Keit A Dorer me Aea Am Peij
editorial.description: Keit Golden Moments e aea research, dorer, aea sources me update peij n katenten me dementia me omo n ninikini, me nan a eab publish.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Am sources

Am guide e bita iat public guidance me eowita organization me raudo, me National Institute on Aging, CDC, Alzheimer’s Association, Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, Family Caregiver Alliance me NHS, me iat research me Cochrane reviews me clinical trials me raudo. Guide me eto e tsimine source ean. A aea source me eto ngago a dorer, me a dorer nane e bita iat nan e dorer.

Keit a dorer

  • Omo dogin ngago: nan wo aea ngago, ian dorer me e eti.
  • Dorer n kor dogin evidence: a dorer “linked with”, “may” me “evidence e mixed” ngago e kor.
  • Kakarau engame: a dorer dogin engame ñe e tsimine dementia bwo engame e raudo, me a eab aea dorer n kiudoita me shaming.
  • Eab tsimine dorer n am: eab tsimine statistics me quotes me experts me research me review n ebo me eab kor.

Amen aea am peij

Peij e dorer me aea bita iat Golden Moments team, me tsimine help ean AI tools dogin research me drafting. Peij me eto e aea iat sources bita iat team. Am peij eab aea bita iat doctor me clinician, me a eab dorer bwo e doctor. E dorer dogin information me general, eab medical advice.

Nan a eab publish

  • Dorer bwo katenten, emera, supplement, fast me routine e prevent, treat, slower me cure dementia.
  • Test, kiudoita me score me e dorer bwo engame e tsimine, me eab tsimine, dementia.
  • Dorer bwo wo start, katei me change edor me medicine.
  • Ad me sponsored content me e bita iat guidance.

Update me dorer n kor

Peij me eto e tsimine date ngago e update. Ngago wo aea mistake me source me eab ebo, email {email} me a aea ean ekaura.

faq.title: Kiudoita me Duwom
faq.seoTitle: Katenten me Dementia: Kiudoita me Duwom
faq.description: Duwom dogin kiudoita me e tsimine dogin katenten n dementia: katenten me omo, e ga reit katenten, nan wo aea ngago e raudo, omo n ninikini me privacy.
faq.lede: Duwom me e eti dogin kiudoita me amen kakarau e kiudoita.

items.q: Meda katenten me omo dogin engame ñe e tsimine dementia?
items.a: Katenten me omo e eti, ata me eab tsimine pressure, me e omo nan engame e mwiya ngago nane. Pija matching me pija e aea, sorting, jigsaws me e eti, dorer me ata bita, coloring me pija bingo e omo dogin engame me eto. Eab aea timer, score me nan e aea exam.

items.q: E kor bwo katenten e free me eab kaniwon?
items.a: Ehe. Akani kakuri ma bwiida me pwerint e dorer (free), eke akaun, eke sain-ap, daunrot me eke katangain.

items.q: Erangan eke skoar, reber, me taima?
items.a: Bita omo me skoar ogona eouweiy bita makur animwen ngeni eketam, me ogona aroweniy me kakarur. Ango anani tsimine ian animwen ma ao karowa, eno eke tsimine me feir me ogona tubwi ian nene ao.

items.q: Aiet masin me animwen ngeni bita?
items.a: Nene terepon, tablet me komputa me tsimine web browser gouw. Bita tablet ian stand ean thebur e animwen bwe arow engame ogona kakuri iturin. Bita laptop me komet ngeni TV e animwen ngeni gurup.

items.q: Ango ogona kakuri ngeni pija ian anga nuwawin?
items.a: Ehe. Photo pairs e eouweiy 2 ngeni 6 pija me om reiet ngeni kakuri me matching. Akani pija e mendet ian om browser me eab upload me seif.

items.q: Aiet ao me makur ogona totow?
items.a: Ngaian 10 ngeni 20 minit e bwo, me nene 2 minit e animwen. Taramwi amen om karameie ean magum me rur me tubwi ngago e animwen. Eke tsimine bita ao me bwiida.

items.q: Ite me re eab rogen makur?
items.a: Kakarameie bita 'eab', me anian teke ian bita ao eke tsimine me gouw. Eab rogen ogona metu tsin magum, ngudu, meturur me eab rogen. Taraw bita anan guide ean aiet makur ngago re ouga 'eab'.

items.q: Aiet makur me animwen ngeni later-stage dementia?
items.a: Animwen ma matani: deretoi musik animwen, kakarameie be ngeni lotion, taraw pija karowa, dobe berangket marur, teki iturin mwimwi, me kakuri pija ewewe ngeni amen iturin. Bita guide ian later-stage e tsimine bwo iedia.

items.q: E tsimine makur ngeni gurup ian mwengo me kakarameie (care home)?
items.a: Ehe. Picture bingo e tsimine kadi me pwerint me caller ian skrin, me Finish the saying ma Conversation cards e animwen ngago ango dorer ebio. Bita anan guide ngeni care home e dorer ean ranga gurup, teki me aroweniy makur.

items.q: Kakuri ogona tubwi me eouweiy dementia me meteketek?
items.a: Eke tsimine kakuri me tsimodu bwe e tubwi dementia, me anan kakuri eab ouga. Makur ian ut ian gurup e tsimodu ian risits bwe ogona kowat amen etokatok me mild ngeni moderate dementia, ma e ewewe me kakuri bwe e tubwi mwiyan. Ango anani kakuri bwe animwen me karowa.

Eab tsimine ropwit. Risits e aroweniy 14 metani emaron ma rogen mour ngeni dementia, ngeni eab dereto, daro ebio, eab makur ma eko engame iturin. Taramwi akani ogona kakarameie ngeni eke engame, ma bwo engame me makur animwen me ouga dementia. Eab tsimine amen eatan.

items.q: Eanimwen intermittent fasting ngeni emaron an ut?
items.a: Aroweniy ean engame e eke bwo, me bwo risits e ian menin. Fasting ogona eouweiy emaron ngeni rodu, ian anani rogen medisene ean diabetes me ibeibe, me eab anian ngeni engame me dementia. Dorer ngeni dokita me eab eouweiy om eam.

Eke akaun me ads. Ango ougid Google Analytics bwe tsieda engame metu me peipa me animwen, me om browser e tsieda ngago soft sounds e on. Pija me om reiet ngeni Photo pairs eab upload. Taraw bita privacy notice ean bwiida.
Eab. Golden Moments e ngeni animwen ma information. Ean emaron, dorer ngeni dokita, me ian emedjensi kiy 111.

handout.title: Kakuri Animwen me Dorer ngeni Engame me Dementia
handout.seoTitle: Peipa Pwerint: Free Dementia Games Online
handout.description: Aiyukw peipa me pwerint ngeni nuwawin ma amen kakarameie ean kakuri pija me dorer (free) ngeni engame me dementia, ngeni gurup me care packet.
handout.lede: Pwerint nene peipa ngeni support group, care packet me dor an fridge. Ougid Print command ian om browser; akani menu me batan eab tsimine ian bita print.
handout.introHtml: Pija ebio, dorer ewewe me eke tsimine me feir. Dorer (free) ian terepon, tablet me komputa, eke sain-ap, eke ads, eke taima me eke skoar. Teki iturin me aroweniy kakarameie.
handout.restHtml:
Bita tips

  • Reiet ao ian ean ngago amen om karameie e animwen.
  • Tubwi ngeni bita ewewe. Aiyukw aie (4) tiles e bwo.
  • Dorer ean akani pija. Bita dorer e bita me animwen.
  • Tubwi ngago e animwen. Tubwi ian nene ao e animwen.

Tsimine ian bita saet

  • Peipa me pwerint me dorer (free): word search me ebio, coloring pages, conversation cards me picture bingo.
  • Iedia ean makur ngeni bita stage, me guide ean kakuri karowa ma kakarameie ean bwiida.

Ngeni animwen ma ao karowa. Eab dorer ean dokita, eketam me metani. Golden Moments e pwerintin Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.restHtml:
Aron kudo re aea

  • Mwio in aea engame ma memory care: bingo in pija me kano-dorer eat TV ian common room, me engame aipwon e tano screen bwiin kudo meikona.
  • Program in rane bwiin engame ro ketaura: tablet station me Picture pairs e oebwi ean tile auwogo, bwiin sessions me e oebwi.
  • Mwio in buk: pepa in word search ma conversation cards ian kits bwiin memory, ma bookmark website eat tablets ian mwio in buk.
  • Kudo in oebwi bwiin ro re aea engame ma memory cafés: pepa aipwon bwe wo print bwiin famili bwe re bweronga mwio.
  • Hospitals ma planners in bweronga mwio: pepa eat packet bwiin ro re aea engame, bwe e bwe nimin me e maraurau bwe re aea eat mwio me irin bed.

Nimin ang ekeow makur ean

Games meikona bwiin aenomwei ma mwaereng in bwieta. Re gonae diagnose, test, score, treat me slow dementia, ma ang dorer kudo bwe re ekeow dorer ean aron eiy.
